title: Add autonomy review artifact scaffold
summary: The status gap report points at signed review artifacts for the autonomous workflow. Add the first truthful step: a read-only unsigned review artifact that binds a task record to its transition events and declared verification commands, without claiming cryptographic signing yet.
expectedFailureModes: Autonomous review evidence remains only in chat or event logs and cannot be exported as one task artifact.
Docs imply signed review artifacts exist before a signing policy or key custody path is implemented.
The artifact command writes files, stages changes, commits, or pushes while only summarizing task evidence.
nextAction: Add an autonomy-review-artifact command for task records, document the unsigned artifact boundary, update status evidence, and validate JSON/text output without writing Git metadata.
